question_text: Construct change_preference(head,old,new) in Python. head identifies a singly linked list of nodes with customer and next attributes; the final next is None. Each customer has preferred_shop. Replace old with new for every matching customer and return the number changed. Return0 for an empty list.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.

marking_points.criterion: Increments count only on match andadvances references.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.test_code:
def change_preference(head, old, new):
    changed = 0
    current = head
    while current is not None:
        if current.customer.preferred_shop == old:
            current.customer.preferred_shop = new
            changed += 1
        current = current.next
    return changed
from types import SimpleNamespace as N
c1=N(preferred_shop="A");c2=N(preferred_shop="B");c3=N(preferred_shop="A")
h=N(customer=c1,next=N(customer=c2,next=N(customer=c3,next=None)))
assert change_preference(h,"A","C")==2
assert [c1.preferred_shop,c2.preferred_shop,c3.preferred_shop]==["C","B","C"]
assert change_preference(None,"A","C")==0
